jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original high quality hand-painted realistic fantasy RPG shop inventory illustration, refined material detail, readable at 168-pixel thumbnail size. Show the entire single purchasable object, centered at three-quarter view, with 8 percent clear margin on every edge. Rich painterly finish, restrained warm light from upper left and faint cool edge highlights for readability on a dark shop background. Native transparent background with actual alpha; no floor, horizon, backdrop, cast shadow plane, person, hands, text, logo, watermark, frame, or display stand. No extra sale items or separate accessories. Do not cut off any part. Subject: Common Glamerweave clothing, one complete indigo blue tailored long tunic and matching trousers arranged as a single wearable outfit on an invisible mannequin, empty sleeves, clear empty collar, no mannequin visible. Soft woven fabric, silver embroidered cuffs, asymmetric short shoulder fold and split hem. A delicate harmless moving illusion is suggested ONLY inside the textile as tiny drifting constellations and curved star trails woven through its folds; contained within the cloth, never floating outside. Complete sleeves and both trouser legs fully visible. No armor, weapon, magical bonus symbols, multiple outfits or ghostly human.
